title: Why it sucks being a Beerschot fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being a... Beerschot fan!
It starts when you're five. Your club goes bankrupt. Gone. So the fans start again. In the fourth division.
Age eight. Your away games are against villages. One of them has a cow next to the pitch. The cow has more fans than you.
Age eleven. Promoted to the first division! You made it back! Two years later... you finish last.
Age thirteen. Your colours are purple and white. Everyone thinks you're Anderlecht. That's worse than relegation.
Age fifteen. Your city rival wins the league. You win... the second division. Your Antwerp friends send you a congratulations card. It says: "Cute."
Age seventeen. Relegated. Again. At this point, the second division feels like home.
That's the thing about being a Beerschot fan. Your club died... and you still showed up.
Bankrupt. Fourth division. Relegated twice. Still here. Still purple. Still not Anderlecht.
Tag a Beerschot fan. Not an Antwerp fan. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
